question: Which of the following state’s government has launched the flagship programme ‘Pedalandariki Illu’ (housing for the poor) scheme in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of **Andhra Pradesh**__ has launched a new initiative named **Pedalandariki Illu **Scheme to distribute the houses among the EWS section people.
 
• People from Andhra Pradesh who belong to the economically weaker sections of society will be given free houses under this scheme.
 
• It is part of Andhra Pradesh's existing **YSR Housing Scheme.**
 
• The major goal of introducing this programme is to offer them a better place to reside so that they do not have to worry about their stay in different places.
 
• Under this initiative, poor individuals in the state's **Kurnool, Nellore, and Visakhapatnam **districts will be able to obtain well-maintained and quality houses.
 
• On November 18, 2020, Chief Minister **YSR Jagan Mohan Reddy** announced this scheme via video conference.
 
• Pedalandariki Illu’ (housing for the poor) scheme was a part of **Navratnu** created by the CM Jagan Mohan Reddy.
 
• The houses will be distributed to around 2500000 persons in the state who do not have a place to reside.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Kudimaramathu is a scheme launched by **Tamil Nadu** for managing small water bodies like ponds, tanks and reservoirs in the state.
 
• **Kerala** LIFE (Livelihood Inclusion and Financial Empowerment) is a comprehensive housing programme launched by the Kerala government for all landless and homeless residents.
 
• Devaraj Urs Housing Scheme is a government-sponsored scheme in **Karnataka** which considers beneficiaries whose family annual income is less than Rs 32,000 in urban areas.
